caption_L1: This line chart is titled Share of households with internet access in Ireland from 2007 to 2018. Response is drawn on the x-axis. A linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 can be seen on the y-axis, labeled Share of households.
caption_L2L3: The share of households with internet access in Ireland increased between 2007 and 2018. This increase went from from slightly less than 0.6 to more than 0.8. The steeper increase in the share of households with internet access in Ireland was between 2007 and 2012. Between 2012 and 2014 the share of households with internet access in Ireland remained more or less stable, and started increasing again between 2014 and 2018.
